headline: US futures point to higher open led by Nasdaq as Anthropic IPO stokes AI enthusiasm ahead of jobless claims and Philly Fed data
raw_text:
- Anthropic is set to debut on Nasdaq under ticker ANT (ANT) after pricing a record $81 billion IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI firm at roughly $1.5 trillion.
- Nvidia (NVDA) trades about 2% higher in thin pre-market action even as Moody’s cuts its credit outlook to stable from positive, citing leadership uncertainty, while affirming its Aa1 rating.
- Pony AI (PONY) climbs about 3% pre-market after posting Q3 revenue of $44.6 million, up 75%, as robotaxi and robotruck scale improve unit economics, while small-cap name GP (GP) drops about 9% amid sharp moves in low-float stocks.
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise 0.97%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) gain 1.76%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) add 0.51%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) edge 0.39% higher before the open.
- NetEase (NTES) falls about 6% pre-market after reporting third-quarter revenue down 1.8% year over year to RMB27.9 billion and net income of RMB8.4 billion, and approving a $0.585-per-ADS dividend.
- Walmart (WMT), PDD Holdings (PDD), Alibaba (BABA) and Williams-Sonoma (WSM) are scheduled to report earnings before the opening bell.
- Initial jobless claims and the Philadelphia Fed manufacturing index are due at 8:30 AM ET, with US leading indicators to follow at 10:00 AM ET.
- Japan’s Nikkei 225 (@NKD) ends about 0.71% higher while Hong Kong’s Hang Seng declines amid ongoing AI-sector caution.
- European equity markets trade slightly higher after a mixed start to the session.
- WTI crude (@CL) holds near $83 per barrel as Middle East shipping risks offset surplus concerns, while gold (@GC) edges lower.
